English: Wooden Workshop
A simple timber-framed shack where monks and novices craft religious tools and repair vestments. Provides basic support for temple activities.
Stone Workshop
A sturdier stone building fitted with workbenches for masons, woodworkers, and metal artisans. Enables improved repairs and sacred object production.
Craftsmens Shed
A cluster of sheds and lean-tos where skilled craftsmen aid in the repair and creation of sacred relics, icons, and temple furnishings.
Artisan Studio
A refined building with dedicated workrooms for master artisans producing intricate reliquaries, illuminated manuscripts, and ceremonial regalia for temple use.
Guild Workshop
A large, stone-built workshop officially recognized by craft guilds, attracting renowned artisans and generating significant temple wealth and innovation.
Toolmakers Hall
Hall for specialist toolmakers producing advanced instruments for both temple artisans and religious ceremonies, greatly enhancing productivity and learning.
Artificers Chamber
Chamber of master artificers producing unique relics and complex mechanisms for temple defense and prestige, drawing pilgrims and enhancing temple fame.
Masters Workshop
A prestigious workshop for the temples greatest craftsmen, producing legendary works, sacred objects, and awe-inspiring ornamentation admired across realms.
Guildhall Workshop
The central guildhall for temple artisans, hosting workshops, archives, and schools for training the next generation of religious craftsmen and scholars.
Sanctuary Workshop Complex
A grand complex housing all temple crafts: reliquary vaults, scriptoria, forges, and schools. It is a beacon of religious learning, wealth, and innovation for the faith.
